newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials turn negative in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials turn negative in late trading.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average shook off its early strong gains and turned negative in late trading, shrugging off a strong bond market and a report that wholesale prices declined in April.
The Dow industrials were off eight to 7266 in choppy late trading after a jump of 77 points at the opening.

The late volatility meant the New York Stock Exchange had to lift index-arbitrage curbs, which had been in place for most of the sesison, at 1448 EDT/1848 GMT. Only minutes later it put the brakes back on at 1502/1902 EDT and lifted them again at 1514/1914 EDT.

U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI), which had been forecast to come in unchanged, fell 0.6 percent. The "core" PPI, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, also took Wall Street by surprise with a fall of 0.1 percent. It was forecast to rise 0.1 percent.
